work.title: Authored provider professional-normalization precondition fixture
authority: Direct user request to implement authored professional normalization proof fixtures, documentation, and feasible tests without creating professional approvals.

intent.productGoal: Make the evidence and invalidation boundary for a future provider normalization explicit without converting observed provider-departure evidence into an autonomous adjustment.
intent.capability: Provide a deterministic authored provider fixture with post-run truth assertions and testable negative approval semantics.
architecturalIntent: Observed provider-departure evidence and professional normalization remain separate objects.
Truth artifacts are excluded from intake.
A future decision must be exact-run and fingerprint bound.
invariants: No professional approval record is authored.
Claims, cash, A/R, controls, gates, and release authority remain unchanged.
acceptanceEvidence: Post-run truth contract and proof semantics manifest.
Future dedicated decision API and invalidation integration test before any approval claim.

decisions.decision: Implement a precondition fixture rather than a professional approval.
decisions.rationale: The existing API lacks normalization-specific authority, subject, amount, and proof semantics.

observedBehaviour: Not yet executed as a browser/API proof; fixture-level assertions establish intended evidence and negative approval boundaries.

evidence.result: 30/30 tests passed, including PROF-NORM-PROVIDER-001 deterministic review-required evidence and zero-approval assertions.
Authored fixture declares review-required provider evidence, zero automatic normalization, zero approval records, and future invalidation assertions.

divergences.expected: A future normalization decision can be persisted, reviewed, and invalidated through a dedicated API.
divergences.observed: Only generic gate decisions exist; no normalization decision API has been implemented.

learning.recurringPattern: Factual provider departure evidence does not establish replacement capacity, attribution, or professional normalization methodology.
learning.improvementProposal: Implement a separate normalization-decision entity only after explicit authority and API contract approval.
durableKnowledge: A G5 gate decision is not a normalization approval.
Invalidated decisions must return to deterministic evidence state and never carry an adjustment forward.
